Decant

Ambient RNA decontamination for single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-seq, with a differential expression test that models ambient RNA instead of subtracting it. No other ambient RNA tool we found offers one.

What is new

  1. Contamination-aware differential expression (ambient_de(), DecantDE()). When disease tissue releases more ambient RNA than controls, an abundant cell type’s disease genes leak into every other cell type and are reported as differentially expressed. Existing tools correct counts and then test. Decant puts each sample’s measured ambient RNA, and its uncertainty, inside the negative binomial model: mu = native expression + ambient. It supports covariates and is robust to outlier samples in large cohorts.
  2. Correction that keeps what cannot be ambient (bayes_cell). Counts far above what ambient RNA could produce in a cell (doublets, rare expressers) keep their molecules; only the expected ambient share is removed.
  3. Never adds counts. Corrected counts are bounded by the observed counts, checked on every run.
  4. Every default is gated. Each component must pass a falsification test against ground truth in CI. Components that failed are kept off and documented.

How it compares

Correction: six tools on real 10x PBMC 4k data

Same cells, soup and clusters for every tool. “Ambient-compatible” foreign counts are marker counts in cell types that do not express the marker, at a level ambient RNA could explain; “not ambient” are those too high to be ambient, mostly B-cell doublets. A good tool removes the first and keeps the second.

Decant SoupX DecontX CellBender¹ AmbiDose scAR
ambient-compatible foreign counts removed 88–95% 76–94% 97–100% 54–98% 67–79% 99–100%
counts that are not ambient removed (lower is better) 14–37% 12–31% 96–100% 4–68% 82–100% 58–82%
native marker signal lost 1–4% 1–2% 2–6% 0–1% 0–6% 18–26%
counts added 0 0 0 0 0 727,390
run time (4 CPU cores) 11 s 12 s 34 s 55 min 73 s 15 min

¹ Reduced CPU configuration; CellBender is designed for a GPU.

Decant removes more ambient-compatible counts than SoupX and AmbiDose on all three marker sets and than CellBender (as run here) on two of three. It keeps the counts that are not ambient, which DecontX, AmbiDose and scAR remove, and it is as fast as the fastest tool. DecontX removes 5 to 9 points more of the ambient-compatible counts. Details and caveats: validation/BENCHMARK.md.

Differential expression (simulated case/control studies)

leaked genes called (of 80), 6 vs 6 null false-positive rate, 6 vs 6 null false-positive rate, 50 vs 50, confounding batch
ambient_de 0 0.05 0.05
SoupX, then edgeR 1.5 0.04 not run
naive edgeR 53 0.22 0.45
naive Wilcoxon not run not run 0.46
subtract ambient, then Wilcoxon not run not run 0.14

Nominal false-positive rate 0.05. In the 6 vs 6 study, correcting with Decant’s bayes rule and then running edgeR was as good as ambient_de; ambient_de is the option that stays valid with covariates such as batch.

Install 

remotes::install_github("kroy3/Decant")

Quick start

The raw (unfiltered) matrix is required: its empty droplets measure the ambient RNA.

library(Decant)
raw <- read_10x_counts("sample/outs/raw_feature_bc_matrix")
cells <- colnames(read_10x_counts("sample/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix"))
d <- split_droplets(raw, cells = cells)
res <- decant(d$cells, d$empties, clusters = my_clusters)
res$corrected   # corrected counts, sparse
res$rho         # per-cell contamination

From Seurat:

obj <- RunDecant(obj, raw = "sample/outs/raw_feature_bc_matrix")  # new "Decant" assay

res <- DecantDE(obj, cell_type = "Microglia", sample_col = "donor",
                formula = ~ diagnosis, raw = raw_paths_by_donor)
subset(res, ambient_driven)   # hits a standard pipeline reports that the soup explains

Limits

  • Real-data evidence is one dataset (PBMC 4k) without ground truth. Species- and genotype-mixing benchmarks are scripted (validation/) but not yet run.
  • The DE results are simulated, from a simulator that follows the model’s own ambient mechanism.
  • Empty droplets that over-represent genes the cells also express are not detected and make the contamination estimate too low.

The full scorecard, design notes and history are in validation/SCORECARD.md; changes are in NEWS.md.
